title: Probability of a Condorcet winner
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with sign-valued output. The Condorcet-winner probability of $f$ is the expected value, over ranking profiles of $n$ voters, of the indicator that the society has a Condorcet winner.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with sign-valued output
caveat: The definitions of the societal outcome and Condorcet-winner predicate, and the probability distribution used for the expectation, are not included in the supplied statement.
